text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—All right! Nobody should come here. 
Since the new storage building went up, 
this one barely gets used at all.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh...! Thank you! 
Thank you sooooo much...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it! When someone comes 
crying to me that desperately, what else 
can I do? 
For now, resting up and calming down comes 
first!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still, suddenly running out of design 
ideas... 
Being an artist must be tough work, huh?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I am a genius Umamusume Racewear 
designer. 
I only make outfits for girls who give me 
that "*Bling!* ☆" spark... but...

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That spark can be terribly fickle... 
Sometimes, it just suddenly goes 
completely cold.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Even so, once I take a job, my 
professional pride demands I produce a 
masterpiece! 
That being said... when inspiration 
doesn't strike, it just doesn't strike.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yet the reminders keep coming. New clients 
keep lining up non-stop. 
I finally snapped and went, "I can't take 
this anymore!" and dashed out of my 
atelier...

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah! Where is my inspiration?! I can't 
go back until I find it! 
I have to break out of this slump 
somehow...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like you've really got it rough... 
Either way, you need to rest right now. 
Save the thinking for after you've calmed 
down. We'll keep you hidden in the 
meantime!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama-san, I brought some futon 
bedding from the dorms. 
And a few other things that might be 
needed...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Drinks, snacks, towels, and a toothbrush 
set. 
Plus a complimentary, super-cute body 
pillow.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama-senpai! Perimeter check 
complete! 
Doesn't look like anyone noticed a thing.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're safe now, Beauty-san. 
If you ever need anything at all, just let 
me know!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what sweet, kind little Umamusume you 
all are. 
While we're at it, do you think I could 
get a warm dinner and some herbal tea for 
dessert?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, sure! I'll go whip something up!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, pretty bold for someone who was 
just wallowing in despair, aren't ya? 
Well, having an appetite is a good sign! 
Flower, I'll give you a hand!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And so, Beauty Anshinzawa secretly took 
up residence at the academy. 
From then on, the five of them...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Beauty-san, lunch is ready~

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Gah! Is it that time already? I spent the 
whole morning zoning out again 
and got nothing done... I really am a 
hopeless woman...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's all right... Please don't be so hard 
on yourself. 
Just take it easy and rest for now.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly. Even I had a total disaster 
in my last race, so... 
Everyone has their off days, y'know!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Right, right. There are deadlines, and 
that "Beauty Dream Cup" matter, 
and all kinds of things, but...

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...! Oh, no! What about this year's muse? 
What are we gonna do?! 
Wah-wah-wah-wah...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't push yourself! You don't have to 
decide right away! 
If there's anything we can do to help, 
please just say the word.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Sigh... I shouldn't have brought that up. 
Mentioning the Beauty Dream Cup and all...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still... I can't help but wonder if it'll 
actually happen or not. 
I was really looking forward to it, after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I understand how you feel. ...But 
Beauty-san seems to be having such a hard 
time, maybe we just have to give up on 
it...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Maybe... But hey, we can't keep her cooped 
up in there forever, right? 
When's a slump like that even supposed to 
go away...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —Asking "when" is far too leisurely.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Chan-me?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Chan-me has a plan. The Beauty Dream Cup 
must be held at all costs.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Beauty-san wouldn't truly want it canceled 
either. 
So... how about we all defeat Mr. Slump 
together?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Chan-me and the rest of us will cheer 
Beauty-san up.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Cheer her up... You're right! 
I might not know anything about design, 
but cheering someone on is something we 
can do...!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh-ho! That beats just sitting around 
waiting! 
I know! Maybe cutting loose and having 
some fun will clear her head!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Sounds splendid. Tomorrow happens to be 
Saturday, so let's go with that. 
Once we brilliantly bust her out of her 
slump, she will surely be deeply grateful.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And that will create what they call 
"connections." 
A special bond with a world-renowned 
designer. *Heart thumps.*

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Operation: Refresh Beauty-san is 
officially underway. 
Let us promptly draft up a field trip 
itinerary.

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: All right!
